description: This Java source file defines the BackgroundSyncActor class, which is an Akka actor responsible for managing background synchronization processes within an Eclipse Ditto service. It handles streaming metadata, managing progress state, handling inconsistencies, and coordinating with various persistence and streaming components to perform background synchronization tasks.

classes.name: BackgroundSyncActor
classes.description: An Akka actor class responsible for background synchronization processes, including streaming metadata, handling inconsistencies, managing progress, and coordinating persistence and streaming components within the Ditto service.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates and returns the Akka Props configuration for instantiating the BackgroundSyncActor with specified dependencies and configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: A static factory method to initialize the Source of BackgroundSyncActor, used internally within Akka to create actor instances.

methods.name: streamMetadataFromLowerBound
methods.description: Streams metadata starting from the specified lower bound ThingId, combining persisted and indexed metadata sources, and filtering for inconsistencies.

methods.name: setProgress
methods.description: Updates internal progress state based on received ProgressReport messages, tracking persisted and indexed progress.

methods.name: bookmarkThingId
methods.description: Creates a bookmark of the current progress state by setting a timestamped bookmark for the smaller of the persisted or indexed progress ThingIds.

methods.name: doBookmarkThingId
methods.description: Persists a bookmark of the current progress by setting a tagged timestamp for the given ThingId.

methods.name: handleInconsistency
methods.description: Handles detected inconsistencies by updating the Thing with an UpdateThing command and emitting appropriate sync events.

methods.name: isInconsistentAgain
methods.description: Determines if an inconsistency has re-occurred by inspecting the event stream for previous sync events with the same thing ID and revision.

methods.name: getLowerBoundSource
methods.description: Retrieves a source of the lower bound ThingId based on the latest bookmarked timestamp, using a default if none is set.

methods.name: getPersistedMetadataSourceWithProgressReporting
methods.description: Creates a source that resumes from the lower bound, reporting progress during the streaming process.

methods.name: getIndexedMetadataSource
methods.description: Creates a source for indexed metadata starting from the lower bound.

methods.name: wrapAsResumeSource
methods.description: Wraps a source creation function into a resume source with backoff and retries, starting from the specified lower bound.

methods.name: nextLowerBound
methods.description: Determines the next lower bound ThingId based on the last batch of metadata, or returns the current lower bound if none.
